## alerts/docs-alerts

```````````````````````````````` example

> Useful information that users should know, even when skimming content.

> [!TIP]

> [!WARNING]
> Urgent info that needs immediate user attention to avoid problems.

> [!CAUTION]
> Advises about risks or negative outcomes of certain actions.
.
````````````````````````````````

## math/docs-block

```````````````````````````````` example
**The Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality**\
$$\left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k b_k \right)^2 \leq \left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k^2 \right) \left( \sum_{k=1}^n b_k^2 \right)$$
.
<p><strong>The Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality</strong><br>
<math-renderer class="js-inline-math" style="display: inline-block" data-run-id="416955d58d198921dcd169bed98fb8fd">$$\left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k b_k \right)^2 \leq \left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k^2 \right) \left( \sum_{k=1}^n b_k^2 \right)$$</math-renderer></p>
````````````````````````````````

## math/docs-dollar-in-math

```````````````````````````````` example
This expression uses `\$` to display a dollar sign: $`\sqrt{\$4}`$
.
<p>This expression uses <code class="notranslate">\$</code> to display a dollar sign: <math-renderer class="js-inline-math" style="display: inline-block" data-run-id="2d4445595a5069d0c89a68cc8d94c70d">$\sqrt{\$4}$</math-renderer></p>
````````````````````````````````

## math/docs-dollar-span

```````````````````````````````` example
To split <span>$</span>100 in half, we calculate $100/2$
.
<p>To split <span>$</span>100 in half, we calculate <math-renderer class="js-inline-math" style="display: inline-block" data-run-id="69847e4ab8abb7990ac057843f762ccf">$100/2$</math-renderer></p>
````````````````````````````````

## math/docs-fence

```````````````````````````````` example
**The Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality**

```math
\left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k b_k \right)^2 \leq \left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k^2 \right) \left( \sum_{k=1}^n b_k^2 \right)
```
.
<p><strong>The Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality</strong></p>
<math-renderer class="js-display-math" style="display: block" data-run-id="efc4e24ef8c5b3a9f1aab6d839cee95c">$$\left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k b_k \right)^2 \leq \left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k^2 \right) \left( \sum_{k=1}^n b_k^2 \right)$$</math-renderer>
````````````````````````````````
